test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: According to Census of India 2011, what is the gap (in %) between male and female literacy rate in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**16.68%**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to Census of India 2011, the gap between male and female literacy rate in India is** 16.68%**.
 
• The gap of** 21.59 % **points recorded between male and female literacy rates in 2001 Census and in 2011 it has reduced to **16.68 %** points.
 
• **Planning Commission** has set up a target of reducing this gap to 10 percentage points by the year **2011-2012**.
 
• Chandigarh, Nagaland, Mizoram, Tripura, Meghalaya, Lakshadweep Kerala and Andaman & Nicobar Islands have Lakshadweep, Kerala and Andaman& Nicobar Islands have **achieved** this target.
 
• The literacy rate for males **82.14 %and females 65.46 %.**
 
• The increase in literacy rate in males and females during 2001-2011 is in the order of** 6.88 and 11.79** percentage points respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The **2011** Census of India or the 15th Indian Census was conducted in two phases, house listing and population enumeration.
 
• The responsibility of conducting the decadal census rests with the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India, **Ministry of Home Affairs**, Government of India.
 
• The Ministry of Home Affairs is headed by **Amit Shah**.
